result.summary: Replaces string-based log callbacks in the bitcoinkernel C API with structured btck_LogEntry objects, delivering message content, thread names, timestamps, source locations, severity levels, and categories directly to consumers. Introduces a dedicated KernelLogger backend to fulfill util/log.h hooks so logging.cpp can be dropped from the kernel library build. Simplifies kernel logging configuration to a single btck_logging_set_min_level call while eliminating pre-connection log buffering and kernel-side formatting options.
result.problem: Downstream consumers of bitcoinkernel received log entries only as formatted strings, forcing them to parse strings to extract metadata like levels, timestamps, or categories. The kernel library also inherited node-specific logging mechanisms from logging.cpp—such as pre-connection buffer management, output escaping, and multi-category toggling—that added unnecessary interface complexity for an embeddable library.
evidence: PR description: 'callbacks operate on formatted strings, so users need to parse the string to get the timestamp, category, level, ... based on which options are set. This is cumbersome, brittle, and inefficient.'

PR description: 'the node logging infrastructure has quite a bit more functionality than is necessary for a library, including ratelimiting, log formatting, outputting, buffering, ... This introduces unnecessary code and interface complexity.'
Addresses and closes RFC #34062 ('separate kernel logging infrastructure').
result.scope_notes: Modifies the public bitcoinkernel C API and its C++ wrapper: btck_LogCallback changes signature from a string slice to a struct pointer, and several configuration functions (such as btck_logging_set_options and btck_logging_disable) are removed.
result.changed_since_previous: No substantial changes to approach or commit structure; rebased on updated dependencies and master.
result.card: This PR replaces string-based log callbacks in the bitcoinkernel C API with structured btck_LogEntry objects, giving consumers direct access to log metadata without string parsing. It introduces an internal KernelLogger backend implementing util/log.h, allowing logging.cpp to be dropped from the kernel library build. The kernel logging interface is simplified to a single minimum-level filter, eliminating pre-connection log buffering and formatting toggles. This closes RFC 34062 and facilitates downstream kernel logging decoupling PRs #30342 and #33847.

risk.why: Changes are confined to bitcoinkernel logging interfaces and internal callback dispatch, where a bug could cause misformatted logs or callback deadlocks in downstream kernel consumers without affecting consensus or node validation.
